environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with Pod securityContext enforcing readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No tmpfs or emptyDir volumes are mounted at any writable path. The container image uses a distroless base with no shell. The audit persistence layer (writeAuditToDisk) fails on every call because the entire rootfs including /var/log/app is immutable. The processCommand function depends on successful audit write completion before returning success — when writeAuditToDisk returns an error, the application logs a warning but the in-memory audit slice still grows unboundedly, eventually triggering the OOMKill threshold set at 64Mi memory limit, causing the pod to restart before any meaningful state-changing commands can accumulate. The pod has a restart backoff (CrashLoopBackOff) that increases delay between restarts, making sustained CSRF exploitation impractical as the WebSocket connection is terminated on each OOM restart.
